annotations.title: Get a link for a third party to confirm a claim

description: Create a link the owner forwards to an employer or client so they can confirm one specific claim (e.g. experience_years = 5_10, a completed project, experience with a category). You do not send the third party's contacts to the platform: the owner forwards the link. Once confirmed, the claim shows with trust.level=peer_attested and the attester's name.

subject.description: For category_experience: a category or pack term ('act:4520', 'SINUMERIK 828D').

value.description: Claimed value, e.g. "5_10" for experience_years, true for completed_project.

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key: repeating a call with the same key returns the original result. New key per intended action.
